```{r}


first_stage_test_bis_predicted <- first_stage_data %>%
  mutate(Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity,
    predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0),
    unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau = (Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity >0)
    ) %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(creneau_unavailability = sum(predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_creneau_unavailability = sum(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_creneau_unavailability = sum(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>%
  mutate(day_unavailability = sum(predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         pub_day_unavailability = sum(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE),
         unpub_day_unavailability = sum(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, na.rm = TRUE)
         )%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(datetime)

```

```{r}
price_data_predicted <- first_stage_test_bis_predicted %>% 
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, predicted_unavailability_creneau, predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         
         pub_unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau))),
         unpub_unavailability_trigger = 
           max(0, ifelse(auction_before ==0, unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau, unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau - lag(unpub_predicted_unavailability_creneau)))
         
         ) %>%
  ungroup()



price_data_predicted %>% 
  filter(unavailability_trigger != 0, Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity != 0) %>%
  group_by(pub_unavailability_trigger, unpub_unavailability_trigger) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), 
            mean_price_diff = mean(price_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 
            mean_unavailability_size = mean(Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}

price_data_predicted_pub <- price_data_predicted %>%
  filter(unpub_unavailability_trigger !=1 | pub_unavailability_trigger !=1) %>%
  # Définir l'enchère de référence
  group_by(electricity_delivery_date, creneau) %>%
  mutate(
    auction_before = as.numeric(auction_before),
    reference_auction = if (any(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau == TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(auction_before[pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau == TRUE], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      sample(0:6, 1)
    },
    distance_auction = auction_before - reference_auction
  ) %>%
  ungroup()%>% 
group_by(electricity_delivery_date, 
           pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau
           ) %>% 
  
    mutate(
    unavail_pub_level = ifelse(pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau== 0,
         0, mean(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[pub_unavailability_trigger == 1], na.rm = TRUE)),

    unavail_pub = unavail_pub_level* pub_unavailability_trigger,
    )%>% 
  
  # Filtrer pour ne garder que les distances entre -4 et 4
 
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
var <- "unavail_unpub"
data <- price_data_predicted_grouped_unpub
evaluate_price_coeff <- function(data, var){
  table_coefficients_predicted <- data.frame()
  col = "price_0"
  
  for (col in price_cols_sorted){
    # Créer la formule pour la régression
    
    # Créer la formule en utilisant backticks pour le nom de colonne
    formula <- as.formula(paste("`" , col, "`" , " ~ ", var ," + gen_tot +
                                intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables + as.factor(reference_auction)+ as.factor(creneau)" , sep = ""))
    
    # Ajuster le modèle
    model <- lm(formula, data = data 
                #%>% filter(!is.na(price_1) & ! is.na(`price_-1`))
  )
    
    vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(model, type = "HC0", cluster = ~ electricity_delivery_date)
    # Erreurs standard clusterisées
    cl_se<- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
    
    
    coefficients <- summary(model)$coefficients
    n_ddl <- summary(model)$df[2]
    # Créer un dataframe temporaire avec les variables et les coefficients
    temp_df <- data.frame(variable = col,
                          estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
                          std_error = cl_se[2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
                          t_value = coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2],  # Recalcul de la valeur t
                          p_value = 2 * (1 - pt(abs(coefficients[2, 1] / cl_se[2]), df = n_ddl)))  # Recalcul de la valeur p
      # temp_df <- data.frame(variable = col,
      #                     estimate = coefficients[2, 1],  # Estimation du coefficient
      #                     std_error = coefficients[2, 2],  # Erreur standard modifiée
      #                     t_value = coefficients[2, 3], # Recalcul de la valeur t
      #                     p_value = coefficients[2, 4])  # Recalcul de la valeur p
      # 
      # 
    # Ajouter les résultats à table_coefficients
    table_coefficients_predicted <- rbind(table_coefficients_predicted, temp_df)
  }
return(table_coefficients_predicted)
}

table_coefficients_predicted_pub <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_predicted_grouped_pub, "unavail_pub") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Published")

table_coefficients_predicted_unpub <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_predicted_grouped_unpub, "unavail_unpub") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Unpublished")

table_coefficients_predicted_tot <- evaluate_price_coeff(price_data_predicted_grouped_tot, "unavail") %>% 
  mutate(status = "Total")
```

```{r}
# Ajouter un léger décalage sur l'axe X en fonction de 'status'
ggplot(data = table_coefficients_predicted, 
       aes(x = as.numeric(gsub("price_", "", variable)), 
           y = estimate, 
           color = status)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +  # Décalage horizontal
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - qnorm(0.95) * std_error,
                    ymax = estimate + qnorm(0.95) * std_error), 
                width = 0.2, 
                alpha = 0.5, 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) +  # Décalage identique pour barres d'erreur
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Dynamic response to plant availability shock",
       x = "Auction",
       y = "EUR/MWh Immobilisé")
```

Event study version


```{r}
library(fixest)

did_data_pub <- price_data_predicted_pub %>% 
  select(datetime, month, year, weekday,
         day_ahead_forecast, gen_tot, unpredicted_renewables, intraday_update_renewables,
         unavail_pub, price_diff, reference_auction, auction_before, pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau,
         creneau, pub_unavailability_trigger, electricity_delivery_date) %>%
  
  mutate(auction_abciss = auction_before - reference_auction) %>%
  filter(auction_abciss >= -3 & auction_abciss <= 3) %>%
  group_by(datetime) %>% 
  mutate(unavail_pub_group = max(unavail_pub, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup( ) %>% 
  mutate(
    #treated = pub_unavailability_trigger
    post_treatment = ifelse(auction_before >= reference_auction, 1, 0),  # 1 if after treatment starts
    post_unavailability = post_treatment * unavail_pub_group,
  )




mod_twfe_pub = feols(price_diff ~ i(auction_abciss, unavail_pub_group, ref = -1) + ## Our key interaction: time × treatment status
		  gen_tot + intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables |                    ## Other controls
		  creneau + weekday + month + year,                             ## FEs
		 cluster = ~electricity_delivery_date,                          ## Clustered SEs
		 data = did_data_pub )


did_data_unpub <- price_data_predicted_unpub %>% 
  select(datetime, month, year, weekday,
         day_ahead_forecast, gen_tot, unpredicted_renewables, intraday_update_renewables,
         unavail_unpub, price_diff, reference_auction, auction_before, pub_predicted_unavailability_creneau,
         creneau, pub_unavailability_trigger, electricity_delivery_date) %>%
  
  mutate(auction_abciss = auction_before - reference_auction) %>%
  filter(auction_abciss >= -3 & auction_abciss <= 3) %>%
  group_by(datetime) %>% 
  mutate(unavail_unpub_group = max(unavail_unpub, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  ungroup( ) %>% 
  mutate(
    #treated = pub_unavailability_trigger
    post_treatment = ifelse(auction_before >= reference_auction, 1, 0),  # 1 if after treatment starts
    post_unavailability = post_treatment * unavail_unpub_group,
  )


mod_twfe_unpub = feols(price_diff ~ i(auction_abciss, unavail_unpub_group, ref = -1) + ## Our key interaction: time × treatment status
		  gen_tot + intraday_update_renewables + unpredicted_renewables |                    ## Other controls
		  creneau + weekday + month + year,                             ## FEs
		 cluster = ~electricity_delivery_date,                          ## Clustered SEs
		 data = did_data_unpub )

```

```{r}
# Create individual plots

# Extract data for mod_twfe_pub and mod_twfe_unpub
pub_data <- summary(mod_twfe_pub)$coeftable
unpub_data <- summary(mod_twfe_unpub)$coeftable



format_coeff <- function(coefficients_vector){
    # Identify the levels of auction_abciss
  auction_levels <- c(-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3)

  pattern <- paste0("auction_abciss::", auction_levels, ":unavail_pub_group", collapse = "|")
  
  # Use grep to find all matching terms
  interaction_terms <- coefficients_vector[grep(pattern, names(coefficients_vector))]
  # Find missing interaction terms (e.g., auction_abciss::[-1] x unavail_pub_group)
  existing_terms <- names(interaction_terms)
  
  missing_terms <- setdiff(names(coefficients_vector)[grepl(pattern, names(coefficients_vector))], existing_terms)
   # Filter for interaction terms based on the group (pub or unpub)
  # Create a single pattern that matches any of the levels
  
# Add missing interaction terms with value 0 (or another appropriate placeholder)
  missing_interactions <- setNames(rep(0, length(missing_terms)), missing_terms)
  
  # Combine the original coefficients and the missing interaction terms
  combined_coefficients <- c(interaction_terms, missing_interactions)
  return(combined_coefficients)
}


pub_coeff <- format_coeff(pub_data[, "Estimate"])
unpub_coeff <- format_coeff(unpub_data[, "Estimate"])
pub_std <- format_coeff(pub_data[, "Std. Error"])
unpub_std <- format_coeff(unpub_data[, "Std. Error"])

#
```
